text: FUCK! These fuck ass nuns keep fucking meowing.
I think their ass is fucking possessed. Fucking fantastic.
It all started when Mother Gertrude walked into Sunday service. Another day at church, right? Wrong.
She decides: you know what? How about I ruin a fucking good morning.
So she meows, like a fucking... motherfucking Maine Coon!
She's only doing this 'cause she gets no attention at home. Stupid... stupid fucking bitch.
Well, you'd think it'd be over after that, right?
FUCKING WRONG! The nun next to her starts meowing along, then the next, then the next. Now the whole church is meowing like it's possessed by a fucking humane society.
Now they do this shit every day. Never mind that it's six o'clock in the GODDAMN MORNING! FUCK!
So now I gotta call an army of soldiers to beat the shit out of these nuns, 'cause they won't shut the FUCK up.
I'd rather rot in hell for pummeling the worshippers of God himself than deal with these nuns meowing at each other like holy hell.
Anyways... they stopped. So that's nice.
